ESA's Cosmic Vision 2015–2025 missions were selected to answer four b

ig questions: What are the conditions for planet formation and the emergence of life? How does the Solar System work? What are the fundamental physical laws of the Universe? and How did the Universe originate and what is it made of? The next space science mission planning cycle is Voyage 2050 , whose key themes will be moons of the giant planets , temperate exoplanets to the Milky Way , and new physical probes of the early Universe .
